sources.label: Synthetic
sources.description: A fully simulated universe of 1,200 hospital-employed cardiologists with a hidden outcome simulated from the model's own hypotheses -- it tests the pipeline, not the hypotheses.

sources.label: Real data
sources.description: Real cardiologists from public CMS Medicare records, hospital-based by billing setting (inferred). The same ten signals, filled from real records where they exist and labeled by provenance; no real outcome to fit weights to, so nothing is scored.
